thag1.1:1.0.1: Theragāthā THERA-GĀTHĀ. Namo tassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa.
thag1.1:1.1: Sīhānaṃ va nadantānaṃ dāṭhīnaṃ girigabbhare suṇātha bhāvitattānaṃ gāthā attupanāyikā: || ||
thag1.1:2.1: yathānāmā yathāgottā yathādhammavihārino yathādhimuttā sappaññā vihariṃsu atanditā, || ||
thag1.1:3.1: tattha tattha vipassitvā phusitvā accutaṃ padaṃ katantaṃ paccavekkhantā imaṃ atthaṃ abhāsisuṃ. || ||
thag1.1:4.0: EKANIPĀTO. Channā me kuṭikā sukhā nivātā, vassa deva yathāsukhaṃ; cittaṃ me susamāhitaṃ vimuttaṃ, ātāpī viharāmi, vassa devā 'ti. || || itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Subhūti thero gātham abhāsitthā 'ti.
